about: Replay each case against the buffering-quality controller with a fake wall clock. Apply each event at its time t (ms on the case clock), advancing the clock between events so timers fire, then advance to until. expect is the complete ordered list of outputs; any other output fails the case. A case's mode defaults to defaults.mode. buffering_action, when present, is the plan_summary value each listed plan must report. Trigger evaluation occurs on playing and an in-progress long-stall timer, not on waiting or suppression expiry while playing. Suppressed history is retained; timeout and rearm clear it. Plan labels identify local adoptions, not unique server plan IDs; a server plan_id may repeat. Compute the step-down estimate as the exact integer floor of delivered_kbps * 7 / 10. A plan_adopted with controllerInitiated false answers a replan the controller did not send. client_replan has an operation (track_change, seek_reanchor, seek_failure_recovery, failure_recovery or output_change): the client sends a replan for its own reasons, and the output is a replan whose body holds that operation, the adopted plan's quality as quality_preference and, on Auto with a kept step-down estimate, bandwidth_estimate_kbps without bandwidth_estimate_source; the client's other request fields are outside these vectors. quality_changed is a quality change the controller did not send, such as the viewer's pick; it has no fields, and the new quality arrives with the next plan_adopted. new_attempt is a new playback attempt of the title; it has no fields, and the cases rely only on its discarding the kept estimate. A waiting with cause renderer began with more than RENDERER_WAIT_BUFFER_MS of media buffered past the playhead: the decoder or renderer is behind, so it is not a stall. A plain waiting during a renderer wait means the media buffered past the playhead fell to RENDERER_WAIT_BUFFER_MS or less, and the stall begins then.

copy.cant_lower: Can't lower quality for this video

cases.name: grace
cases.note: The first stall ends before the grace does, so only one stall counts.

cases.name: slow_start
cases.note: No frame yet, so the grace runs from the first wait.

cases.name: outage
cases.note: The stall is re-timed when transport recovers, so it counts as one 1000 ms stall.

cases.name: lower_again
cases.note: The undo pill times out at 149000; the lower plan keeps playing.

cases.name: picked_quality
cases.note: always still asks about a quality the viewer picked.

cases.name: timeout
cases.note: The second trigger, at 191000, is inside REOFFER_MIN_MS of the first offer.

cases.name: unadopted_replan
cases.note: Rearm counts from the replan at 131000, so the stall at 156000 is ignored and the one at 206000 is not.

cases.name: back_hides_undo_without_answering
cases.note: The undo pill times out at 149000; the lower plan keeps playing.

cases.name: kept_estimate_on_later_replans
cases.note: The client's own Auto replans repeat the lowering's estimate without a source. An adoption the controller did not request keeps it.

cases.name: kept_estimate_replaced_by_next_lowering
cases.note: The undo pills time out at 149000 and 224000.

cases.name: quality_change_discards_kept_estimate
cases.note: The undo pill times out at 149000. The viewer picks 1080p-high, then Auto again.
